Thus every word avoiding the proposed A,B,C families occurs as a periodic factor, and every family word is minimally absent because its prefix and suffix occur. Families are disjoint, with cardinalities q(q-2), q, and sum_i(a_i-1)=p-q, so total p+q(q-2), with the stated length enumerator. Independently generated circular factor sets for 250 small run profiles matched this classification. The proof is all-parameter; finite checks only corroborate it.
